{{Infobox auto|title=Prayer of Daedalus|type=[[Blessing]]}}
The '''Prayer of Daedalus''' is a [[blessing]], a crafted enchanted book that stores {{MCW|Efficiency}} III and [[Unbreaking]] III. It is crafted from a [[Divine Favor]], a diamond pickaxe, a diamond axe, four [[Estus Ash]] and a diamond, and is the only craftable source of Unbreaking III and of Efficiency.

== Obtaining ==
=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
The book in the center must be a [[Hell-Bound Book]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/blessing/efficiency_unbreaking.json}}</ref> The crafted item is named "Blessing", with "Prayer of Daedalus" as a dark gray lore line.

== Usage ==
The Prayer of Daedalus is applied to equipment in an [[anvil]], like an {{MCW|Enchanted Book|enchanted book}}. Efficiency applies to mining tools, and Unbreaking to any item with durability. The only other source of Efficiency besides loot is the Prayer of The God-King [[Ofuda]] (Efficiency II and Unbreaking I).

== Trivia ==
* Daedalus is the craftsman and inventor of Greek myth, father of Icarus (see [[Elegy of Icarus]]). The developer thanked a contributor in the {{Version|1.12.1-alpha}} release notes with "may you be blessed by Daedalus himself".<ref>{{Cite changelog|1.12.1-alpha|quote=Thank you, HapppySpud, for your work, and may you be blessed by Daedalus himself}}</ref>
